fact: The Ministry of Health's mid-term review of the Health Sector Medium Term Development Plan 2022-2025 (October 2024) states that LHIMS is being implemented nationwide as an electronic medical record system running on local servers at the facilities, and that the absence of a national digital health policy to guide ICT integration into the health sector has led to inadequacies in coordinating health information systems.
title: Report of the Mid-Term Review of the Health Sector Medium Term Development Plan (2022 – 2025)
